decisions.reason: As a recent extension of the firm's core coolant-management business in a growing machinery market, it is a low-cost option to keep open while demand information is still limited.
The centrifuge fits the firm's established filtration and process-media capabilities, so management would likely retain it while learning about uptake and application breadth.
Although a multi-model line can later be rationalized, coolant nozzles are close to the core offer and likely inexpensive to maintain, so the option value of staying in the market remains positive.

Because this conveyor is only close rather than fully central to the established offer, it carries somewhat higher uncertainty, but after just one year a large diversified engineering firm would usually continue testing the market.
This product builds directly on the firm's existing chip-conveying portfolio and service network, making it attractive to keep as a complementary option with limited incremental risk.

The hinged belt conveyor is adjacent to the core range and may face overlap with other conveyor variants, but the firm would likely keep it for now because uncertainty has not yet resolved enough to justify abandonment.
